347)༄༅/na mo gu ru lo kī shwa ra ya/skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bo bka' drin can/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/rje

tei:div.tei:p: 347) ༄༅/ na mo gu ru lo kī shwa ra ya/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bo bka' drin can// bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs// thugs rjes chen po byin gy-is rlobs// spyan ras gzigs kyis byin= 'gro ba'i mgon pos byin= 'jig rten dbang pos= rgyal sras mchog gis= yid bzhin nor bus= oṃ ma ṇi d+me hūm̐/ bdag sogs ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi// ngan sems gdug rtsub zhi bar byin= bsam sbyor dge la 'gyur bar= nad gdon bar chad zhi bar= sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par= byang chub sems mchog 'byongs bar= rgyal sras spyod la 'jug par= 'brel tshad don dang ldan par= bde chen zhing du skye bar= gzhan don sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ

lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi mas gsungs so// ༈ nyi ma mkha' khyab 'gro don ni/ bdag nyid thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ lo gsar tshes gcig gi nyi ma 'char ba dang shar du kha bltas la mdun rten gsal gdab pa ni/ hrīḥ nam mkha' chos sku stong pa spros bral klong*// nyi ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag gi thugs nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi// yig bdun 'gro 'dul sprul sku snying rje'i lha// sdug bsngal rang grol spyan ras gzigs dbang= sogs nas/ lha 348) bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ phyag mchod/ bstod pa yan grub nas/ mdun rten thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka= sogs nas/ las nyon sbyangs// phyi snod 'jig rten po ta la yi zhing*// nang bcud sems can spyan ras gzigs su gyur/ yig bdun brgya stong ci nus bzla/ tshogs mchod rab gnas dang bcas mdun bskyed mi bsdu bar bzhag lo zad gnam gang gi dgong mo mchod bstod gsol ba btab nas/ nyi ma rgas khar/ snod bcud nyi ma'i dal la 'dus// de yang yig bdun hrīḥl thim// ye shes pa rnams rang gnas gshegs// dam tshig rang gi thugs kar thim/ bsngo smon sogs bya'o/ ༈ chu bo dbyings khyab 'gro don ni/ sprel zla'i tshes gcig nas rdo la yig bdun 'khor lo bskos pa dkyil 'khor dbus su bkod de zhag bdun bsgrubs mthar mi khyis mi 'gom zhing kunagyis longs spyod pa'i chu bo chen por dor/ rten las yig bdun dpag med 'phros// sems can kun gyi don byed gyur// chu yis gar khyab yig bdun khyab// bskal pa'i bar du chu de nyid// mthong thos myang reg thams cad dang*// rlangs pa'i char gyis reg pa tshun// 'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te// thugs rje'i go 'phang thob par shog rat+na'i gzhung las ma ṇis btus/ 349) ༄༅/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs rigs drug gi /sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas*// pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med pa ni// rgyal ba bden par smra bas yang yang gsungs/

blo sna chos la sgyural/ mchan/ thog ma med nas da lta yan chad du// lag mthil tsam gyi sa yi khyon la yang*/ lan grangs mang po skye 'chi ma myong ba/ med pas rdzus skyes drod gsher skye ma gtogs// pha ma med par skye ba mi srid pas// sems can kun gyis pha ma byas par nges/ de yang lan gcig tsam du ma yin par// ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam// ril bur dril yang sa yis longs mi 'gyur// de phyir sems can phra rags ci mthong yang*// pha ma yin pa'i 'du shes yang yang bya// mar gyur tshi yang drin dang ldan nges te// rang re bar do'i rnam shes 'khyams po zhig /ma yi mngal du thog mar bzung ba nas// srog med pa la srog kyang byin pa yin// lus kyi bcud dang zas kyi dngas mas bskyed// zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar du mngal du bzung*/ dus tshod/ mchan/ /btsas pa'i tshe yang shi na dbugs ma chad// gson na mgo mi theg pa'i ro 'dra de// rigs rgyud skam dang 'chi rgyu 'chi ma bcug /lag gis blangs nas lus kyi drod la sbyar// zas kyi dang po mngar ba'i nu zho bsnun// 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang byams pa'i mig gis bltas// snabs lud khas 'jib mi gtsang lag pas phyis// rtse ba'i sems dang snyan pa'i ngag gis 350) bos// dro grang 'dzub mos 'grang ltogs lag pas byug /bu na ba las rang nyid shi ba 'dams/ srog ched/ mchan/ /lus med pa la lus kyang byin pa yin// zas kyi phud byin gos kyi rtses g.yogs nas// yo byad med la yo byad bstabs pa dang*// za tshul gyon tshul smra tshul 'gro tshul bslabs// 'jig rten mi shes pa la 'jig rten bstan// chung ngu 'phang lo tsam pa'i nus med de// chen po g.yag tsam ma gyur bar du ni// ma yi bka' drin kho nas byung ba yin// chos kyi phyogs nas dal 'byor bco brgyad kyi// lus rten 'di yang a ma'i drin gyis byung*// da lta'i zas gos gnas mal yo byad sogs// mthun rkyen ci mchis a ma sems can drin// dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed yul// bar du rdzogs smin sbyang gsum bya ba'i yul// mthar ni mngon par rdzogs par tshang rgya nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i yul gyur ni// sems can med na mi 'byung de dag drin// da lta a ma sems can thams cad ni*// me stag phra mo phog pa'i sdug bsngal nas// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*// sdig pa mi dge nyid ni bag med spyod// sdug bsngal bden pas dngos su gnod pa dang*// kun 'byung bden pas rgyud nas gnod pa yin// nyi ma dron mo yud tsam lde ba nas// mngon mtho nges legs bde ba 'dod na yang*// de'i rgyu dge ba rang gis sgrub mi shes// sgrub tshul slob pa'i bla ma'i ngag mi nyan// bde ba nyin

351)mo'i skar ma bzhin du dkon// lam log mgo rmongs long ba thang dkyil lus// bde sdug go log sgrub pa'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'di dang bral bar shog /sdug bsngal 'di dang bral na ci ma rung*// sdug bsngal 'di dang bral bar bdag gis bya// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'di dang dus rtag tu// bral bar bla ma dkon mchog thugs kyis zungs// de ltar rtsa ba'i man ngag rim gyis ni// nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam bar du sgom pa ni// zur dang snying rjes sems can dmigs pa yin// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral nas kyang*// mngon mtho lha dang mi y-i bde ba ni// sngon chad lan grangs mang por thob myong mod// mi rtag pas na de la dgos pa med// zhi ba nyan rang go 'phang bkod na ni// 'brum nad byang ba'i skyes bu ji bzhin du// srid par slar mi ldog pa yin na yang*// rgyal sras lam dang sangs rgyas 'bras bu yi// yon tan med pas de la dgos pa chung*// bdag gis da res dal 'byor mi lus thob// mtshan ldan bla ma bsten nas zab mo yi// gdams pa rgyud la thob pa'i dus 'di ru// de sngon khe dang rgyal kha nga la byin// gyong dang bub kha ma yis blangs ba yin*// da res khe dang rgyal kha ma la byin// gyong dang bub kha rang gis blangs nas kyang*// a ma sems can srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha'// zhi ba myang 'das mtha' gnyis las 'das pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par bya// de nas 352)rang nyid ji ltar 'gro na song*// sems can don ched bsam pa dpe med sems// rang gzhan mnyam 'gro ye shes dam pa'i sems// dang po rang nyid rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol// thugs rjes gzhan rgyud bstan dang 'gro ba'i don// rgya che nam mkha' rgyun ring skal mang mtha'// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyis// bskal pa gaṅga'i klung gi bye snyed kyi// bar du sems can gzhan gyi don mdzad pa// bdag gis skad cig nyid la bsgrub par bya// de ltar bsam pa zur ni rjes ma ste// shes rab kyis ni rdzogs byang dmigs pa dang*// 'bras bur dam bca' smon pa sems bskyed dang*// rgyu la dam bca' 'jug sems bcas pa tshang*// de dag bsam pa rgya che byang chub sems// sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa bya ba yin// lugs gnyis mthun par 'grogs pa'i grogs dam pa// skal bzang phrin las thugs bzhed bzhin du ni/
'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros zhes byas bris/ don 'di rgyud la ma skyes bar du sgoms// 'u bus 'di nyid 'don pas 'thus pa yin/ mchan/ dge'o//
